The first time we came here, a bit of a drive from home, about 15 minutes on a Sunday (less traffic), we ordered the usual fare of Vadas, Dosas, and some delectable hot Mangalore Buns, and we loved the food. The prices are better than reasonable.
The second time we’re here we absolutely love the food even more.
This is starting to become a Sunday morning tradition for us and we’ll keep coming back here more often I think.
Next time I’ll try the Special South Indian Meal.

Visited Udupi Sambaram at Kogilu Cross and tried their coffee, masala dosa and rava onion dosa. The dosas were really good and had a nice taste, but the coffee was the highlight for me — it was extraordinary. They have both AC and non-AC seating available. Parking is available, although the space is limited and only a few vehicles can be accommodated. Overall, a good place for South Indian food and definitely worth trying for the coffee and dosas.
